row_grain: one emitted event before replay removal
segment_assignment: fixed per user throughout the source
cohort_rule: earliest qualifying first-step event per user inside the selected midnight-to-midnight UTC window

eligibility.next_event: earliest matching event strictly after the previous qualifying event and within follow-up
eligibility.select_from: users who reached the previous step

modes.exact_row: retain one copy of each identical row

replays.event_id_conflict: reject differing rows with the same event_id
replays.repeated_action: keep distinct event IDs and use only the first eligible one at each step

timestamps.invalid: exclude missing or malformed timestamps and count the excluded rows after replay removal
timestamps.unresolvable_tie: reject duplicate event_order for distinct events of the same user

metrics.reached_users: distinct qualifying users at this step
metrics.dropoff_users: previous reached users minus current reached users
metrics.dropoff_rate: dropoff users divided by previous reached users
metrics.reconciliation: mobile reached users plus desktop reached users equals overall reached users at every step
